sources.title: Fourth quarter implosion sends WSU to 1-7 in 31-10 loss to No. 21 Boise State
sources.description: Enterting the final 15 minutes, the one-win Washington State Cougars were tied with the No. 21 Boise State Broncos. Before a critical 4th and 2 for the Bronco offense, most of the WSU team was dancing along to the music blaring over the speakers and the crimson LED lights flashing above.
